distributions.name: E^-1d²σ/dx dy (\nu_\mu, E=35 GeV)
distributions.provenance: HepData record ins691719 (Phys.Rev.D 74 (2006) 012008, hep-ex/0509010), CSV export Tables 25-159. Tables 25-92 are NUMU FE and 93-159 are NUMUBAR FE double-differential cross sections; each HepData table groups 3 Bjorken-x sub-tables of E^{-1} d^2sigma/dx dy versus inelasticity y at fixed neutrino energy. Regrouped into 34 2D distributions (17 energies x 2 beams), each holding up to 12 x-slices (x=0.015-0.75); within a slice each row is a y bin (standard NuTeV y binning, terminal bin 0.9-0.97). Value is the released (10^38/E) d^2sigma/dx dy column in 10^-38 cm^2/GeV; per-bin err = sqrt(stat^2 + sys^2) from the released stat and combined-systematic columns. The additional 2.1 percent overall normalization uncertainty is a global scale and is not folded into per-bin errors. Bins flagged '-' (no measurement) are omitted. Tables 1-24 (F2 and xF3 structure functions) are not cross sections and are not ingested. No full covariance matrix is released, so none is attached. Target tagged Fe (per-nucleus iron).
